item.title: Jeffries 'thankful' US airman was rescued but criticizes 'reckless and costly war'
item.summary: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries called the rescue of a U.S. airman in Iran "heroic," but continued to criticize what he called a "war of choice" with Iran.

item.title: WATCH: Father and son share special moment on World Autism Awareness Day
item.summary: ABC News' Danny New shares the special moment when ESPN analyst Dan Orlovsky brought his son Madden who has autism onto "NFL Live."

item.title: WATCH: Jobs report shows strong hiring in March, despite oil shock set off by Iran war
item.summary: The U.S. recorded strong job gains in March, rebounding from dismal losses, even as the nation weathered a global oil shock set off by the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, a jobs report on Friday showed.

item.title: Trump says 'we're blowing up the whole country' if no Iran deal in 48 hours
item.summary: President Donald Trump told ABC News if Iran doesn't make a peace deal in the next 48 hours, "we're blowing up the whole country."

item.title: WATCH: Artemis II orbits Earth for full day, takes critical step in path towards the moon
